description.en: Citation-first tutoring over your own scanned books: every answer carries a locator that opens the page image.
description.zh: 对自己收藏的扫描本书库做引用优先的苏格拉底式教学：每个回答都带可回页的定位。

description.en: 12 tools: cited search, chapter lookup (卷/篇/回), page images, math verification, session review. Needs a companion sidecar.
description.zh: 12 个工具：引用检索、章回定位、页图、公式校验、会话复盘。需配套 sidecar。
